description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ModuleDao class in the OrangeHRM project. It tests various DAO operations like retrieving module lists, updating module statuses, and fetching disabled modules, specifically within the context of the OrangeHRM admin plugin module.

classes.name: ModuleDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the ModuleDao, testing database interactions related to system modules within the OrangeHRM admin plugin context.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture by creating a ModuleDao instance and populating the test database from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testGetModuleList
methods.description: Tests retrieving the list of modules and validates the expected count and properties of the first module.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatus
methods.description: Tests updating module statuses and verifies the changes with fetchObject.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatusForReturnedValues
methods.description: Ensures the updateModuleStatus method returns the correct number of Module objects with appropriate status after updates.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatusWithModulesDoesNotExists
methods.description: Checks behavior when updating statuses with a module name not present; verifies that such modules are ignored.

methods.name: testDisabledModuleList
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of disabled modules list and its contents.
